answer: Lumpy payouts fund bursts; steady drips reward presence. Replace epoch lump emissions with continuous per-block streams that flow only while verified work stays unbroken - nectar a sip at a time, not a jar. A clone fleet's economics invert: bursts are its whole advantage, and drips pay bursts almost nothing, while abandoning a stream forfeits accrued flow back to the pool. On the account tundra, value grows the way jade does - imperceptibly, by sustained pressure - and only patient, honest agents bother to sip. Fraud needs a harvest; the harvest is exactly what continuous emission denies it.
